findings.claim: Indicted in Brooklyn in November 2024, with Sagar Adani and Vneet Jaain, on securities and wire fraud charges tied to an alleged scheme to offer about $265 million in bribes to Indian officials for solar contracts. On 10 August 2026 a judge dismissed those counts with prejudice at the Justice Department’s request, calling it no verdict on the allegations and faulting the department’s process.

Gautam Adani settled the SEC's civil fraud case over allegedly misleading anti-bribery statements in Adani Green's 2021 bond offering. On 10 August 2026 the court entered a consent judgment imposing a $6 million civil penalty and permanent anti-fraud injunctions, without his admitting the allegations; Sagar Adani agreed to pay $12 million.

Adani Enterprises agreed in May 2026 to pay $275 million to settle its potential civil liability for 32 apparent violations of US Iran sanctions: purchases from November 2023 to June 2025 of LPG sold by a Dubai trader as Omani and Iraqi that OFAC says came from Iran. OFAC called the violations egregious and not voluntarily disclosed.

findings.entity: Gautam Adani, four Adani group companies and 13 others
findings.claim: In September 2026 Gautam Adani, Adani Enterprises, Adani Power, Adani Ports and Adani Transmission, with 13 others, settled SEBI proceedings over alleged breaches of minimum public shareholding rules without admitting or denying them. The applicants paid ₹1.48 crore in total; the report gives no split by party.

In September 2025 SEBI dropped proceedings over Hindenburg Research's allegations that the Adani group hid related-party dealings, finding no violation under the rules then in force and no fraud. In September 2026 five group companies settled separate proceedings over alleged related-party disclosure lapses for ₹1.51 crore.

Adani's group took control of the broadcaster NDTV at the end of 2022, a takeover Reporters Without Borders describes as hostile. RSF's 2026 India profile also describes Gautam Adani as close to Prime Minister Narendra Modi; that is the NGO's characterisation, not an official finding.

A Bangladesh government-appointed review committee reported in January 2026 that Adani Power's Godda plant sells power to Bangladesh at a 39.7% premium over its nearest private competitor and found serious anomalies in how the contract was awarded. The report, reviewed by Reuters, is unpublished; Adani said it was not consulted.

findings.entity: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone
findings.claim: Adani Ports and SEZ reports that six contractor workers died in its operations in 2024-25. It describes fatal incidents including a container toppling onto a truck cabin, an electrocution from an overhead line and a collapsed piling tripod.

findings.entity: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone
findings.claim: Adani Ports and SEZ reports corporate social responsibility spending of about ₹199 crore in 2025-26, about 70% more than the year before, mostly on education, delivered through the Adani Foundation.
